check_connection.title: Check connection
check_connection.description: Confirm the API token works by listing the APIs the token's user can access, the catalogue verification endpoint. Returns the apis array; an Unauthorized or Token Invalid error means the token is wrong.

output.description: apis: each with apiName, apiSubdomain, apiDocumentationUrl and the apiIsPrivate, apiIsPublic, apiIsTeam, apiIsPersonal flags.

apis.description: The APIs the user can access.

get_me.title: Get my user information
get_me.description: Get the authenticated Apiary user's id and name, plus the teams they belong to with each team's id and API-list URL. Use the teamId with list_team_apis.
get_me.notes: Apiary documents this endpoint with an `Authorization: Bearer` header; the catalogue sends the legacy `Authentication: Token` header, which the official apiary-client also uses for /me/apis.

output.description: userId, userName, userApisUrl and teams (teamId, teamName, teamApisUrl).

list_apis.title: List my APIs
list_apis.description: List every API project the user can access: public and private, personal and team. Each entry gives the API name, its subdomain (the id the blueprint tools take) and documentation URL. Use list_team_apis for one team only.

output.description: The API projects, each with apiName, apiSubdomain, apiDocumentationUrl, apiIsPrivate, apiIsPublic, apiIsTeam and apiIsPersonal.

list_team_apis.title: List a team's APIs
list_team_apis.description: List the public and private API projects of one team the user belongs to. Take the team id from get_me. Each entry gives the API name, subdomain and documentation URL.
list_team_apis.notes: Apiary documents this endpoint with an `Authorization: Bearer` header; the catalogue sends the legacy `Authentication: Token` header.

output.description: The team's API projects, each with apiName, apiSubdomain, apiDocumentationUrl and visibility flags.

create_api_project.title: Create an API project
create_api_project.description: Create a new Apiary API project from an API Blueprint document. If desired_name is taken as a subdomain, Apiary generates a different one; the response gives the domain actually assigned and the documentation URL.

type.description: Whether the project belongs to the user or to their team.

public.description: True for public documentation, false for private.

desired_name.description: Preferred subdomain for the project, e.g. myapi (docs at myapi.docs.apiary.io).

code.description: The API description document, e.g. an API Blueprint starting 'FORMAT: 1A'.

output.description: status (created), domain (the subdomain assigned) and url of the documentation.

get_blueprint.title: Fetch an API Blueprint
get_blueprint.description: Fetch the current API description document (API Blueprint or other source) of one API project by its subdomain. Returns the raw document text in code. Take the subdomain from list_apis.

api_subdomain.description: The API project's subdomain (apiSubdomain), e.g. publicpersonalapi.

output.description: error (false on success), message, and code: the full API description document.

publish_blueprint.title: Publish an API Blueprint
publish_blueprint.description: Replace an API project's description document with new API Blueprint source and publish it, which regenerates the project's documentation and mock server. The previous document is overwritten, so fetch it first with get_blueprint if you need to keep it.

code.description: The complete new API description document, e.g. an API Blueprint starting 'FORMAT: 1A'.

output.description: An empty object on success; on a parse failure, an error with message and parserError.
